I replied to Tobias in his DM: he should keep **Friday 30 Oct at 8:30** free for the Marrow Fieldworks call.

- **Where this comes from:** On 14 Oct, Tobias told me in this DM that his standing Thistle rollout call with the Marrow Fieldworks team is now on Fridays at 8:30. The knowledge base saves his DMs and only he can see them. Nothing newer changes that time.
- **Calendar:** That call isn't on his calendar for next week, so I told him the only record of it is his note to me. I didn't change his calendar.
- **Privacy:** I only used his own DM history, his calendar and the list of channels he belongs to. I didn't read any other channels or use the workspace-wide message search.
